biography: Brad Woods, a name whispered with respect and a touch of exasperation in the Australian racing scene, hails from the sun-drenched shores of the Gold Coast. Unlike many racers groomed in karting academies, Brad's path was forged in the gritty world of amateur V8 Supercar racing. His father, a panel beater with a passion for motorsport, instilled in him a deep understanding of car mechanics and a relentless competitive spirit. Brad's defining moment came during the Bathurst 1000 support race in 2021. Starting from the back of the grid due to a qualifying mishap, he carved his way through the field with a series of audacious overtakes, ultimately finishing second. This performance caught the eye of Reiza Racing, who quickly signed him to their development program. Now, at 23, Brad is at the peak of his abilities, a formidable defensive driver in the Reiza Racing stable, aiming for championship glory.
drivingStyle: Brad's driving style is a masterclass in defensive prowess. He is notoriously difficult to overtake, positioning his car with uncanny precision and extracting every last ounce of grip from his tires. While not the flashiest driver on the grid, Brad excels at managing races, consistently bringing his car home with minimal wear and tear. He thrives under pressure, rarely making mistakes, and has a knack for capitalizing on the errors of his rivals. His corner entry is calculated, prioritizing exit speed and track position over flamboyant slides.
rivalries: Marco Rossi: A fiery Italian driver known for aggressive overtaking maneuvers. Their rivalry stems from a controversial incident at Phillip Island where Rossi punted Woods off the track in the final lap.

Aisha Khan: A highly talented female driver with a natural flair for speed. Brad and Aisha have clashed multiple times due to their contrasting driving styles, with Aisha often criticizing Brad's defensive approach.
Kenji Tanaka: A stoic and methodical Japanese driver. Their rivalry is built on mutual respect and a constant battle for consistency and strategic supremacy in long-distance races.
quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky socks, gifted to him by his grandmother.
Listens to classical music precisely 45 minutes before every race.
Meticulously cleans his racing gloves before each session, believing it brings him focus.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about how fast you can go; it's about how well you can control the chaos."
careerHighlight: Winning the Brazilian Stock Car Pro Series race at Interlagos in 2023. He started 8th and defended against relentless pressure from seasoned veterans to claim his first major international victory.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final corner of the 2022 Bathurst 12 Hour race. A momentary lapse in concentration cost him and his team a certain victory.
